acceptance_rule: Only discrete identity, topology, hash, shape, protocol, partition, and budget invariants may fail by exact comparison. Human, sensor, mounting, kinematic, observability, prediction, and posture evidence must carry uncertainty or a broad nontradeable manifold gate and must be mutation-qualified.
